verdict.rationale: Docs give a concrete self-serve path: add one line of code to require payment, use the hosted CDP Facilitator to verify/settle, and get discovered on the Bazaar automatically with no registration form or agreement required; community builders (httpay.xyz, Apiosk) confirm they actually stood up x402-gated endpoints this way. Missing for 10: no independent audit of the full merchant onboarding flow beyond docs/forum comments, and no explicit description of any formal merchant agreement/compliance step for higher-volume sellers.
